## Why it works this way

The narrative: the tradeoffs, the alternatives that were rejected, and what
would break if it were done the obvious way instead. Facts alone don't build
a model — a reader who knows *why* can reason about cases this page doesn't
cover, and that's the whole point of an explanation page.
